title: Tandem repeat variation shapes immune cell type-specific gene expression
title_zh: 串联重复变异塑造免疫细胞类型特异性基因表达
abstract: Tandem repeats (TRs)—highly polymorphic, repetitive sequences across the human genome—are important regulators of gene expression but remain underexplored due to challenges in accurate genotyping and analysis1. Here we generate whole-genome and single-cell RNA sequencing from more than 5.4 million blood-derived cells across 1,925 individuals in two cohorts2, and perform meta-analysis to characterize the impact of variation in more than 1.7 million TR loci on immune cell type-specific gene expression. We identify more than 69,000 single-cell expression quantitative trait loci, 30.7% of which are specific to 1 of 28 immune cell types, and reveal dynamic regulatory effects using cell-state inference. Matched single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin with high-throughput sequencing profiles from more than 3.4 million nuclei in 922 individuals3 uncover chromatin accessibility quantitative trait loci for nearly one-third of expression-associated TRs, supporting coordinated effects on cis-regulatory architecture. Fine-mapping implicates 1,490 TRs as candidate causal drivers of gene expression in 6.1% of tested genes, and colocalization analyses highlight more than 200 genes in which TRs likely mediate genetic associations with immune and haematological traits. Together, these results provide a genome-wide, multiomic view of TR-mediated regulation in the human immune system, establishing TRs as key contributors to cell type-specific regulatory variation and complex trait architecture. Whole-genome sequencing and cell-level gene expression measurements show that length variation in tandem repeats in the human genome contributes to cell type-specific differences in gene regulation and expression, as well as the architecture of complex traits.
abstract_zh: 串联重复（TRs）是人类全基因组中高度多态的重复序列，是重要的基因表达调控因子，但因基因分型与分析准确性方面的挑战而未得到充分探究1。在此，我们对两个队列2中1,925名个体的540万余个血液衍生细胞进行了全基因组测序和单细胞RNA测序，并开展元分析，以表征超过170万个TR位点的变异对免疫细胞类型特异性基因表达的影响。我们鉴定到超过69,000个单细胞表达定量性状位点，其中30.7%特异于28种免疫细胞类型中的1种，并利用细胞状态推断揭示了动态调控效应。来自922名个体中340万余个细胞核的转座酶可接近染色质高通量测序配对数据3，为近三分之一的表达关联TRs发现了染色质可及性定量性状位点，支持其对顺式调控结构的协调影响。精细定位将1,490个TRs确定为6.1%经检验基因的基因表达候选致病驱动因子，同位点分析显示，超过200个基因的TRs可能介导其与免疫和血液学性状的遗传关联。这些结果共同提供了人类免疫系统中TR介导调控的全基因组、多组学视图，确立了TRs作为细胞类型特异性调控变异和复杂性状结构的关键贡献者。全基因组测序和细胞水平基因表达测定表明，人类基因组中串联重复的长度变异有助于基因调控和表达的细胞类型特异性差异，以及复杂性状的结构。
